patch.value: pm list --no-truncate/--all: explicit override of any --limit + surface total vs returned count (GH-154)

pm list already returns all rows when no --limit is set, but there is no explicit flag to (a) override a provided --limit and (b) signal intent. Add --no-truncate (alias --all) that forces full results and is documented as the 'give me everything' flag for large-corpus audits.
Shipped pm list --no-truncate/--all + result.total + documented --include-body bulk retrieval. GH-154/GH-223.
